kernel.governing_law: The speaker navigates a saturated, chaotic street economy where abundance drowns, intoxicants mask rawness, and everyone — poor, kids, the speaker — is propelled past each other by excess, velocity, and competitive display; relation is serial near-miss, not mutual hold.
kernel.mutated_relation: The abundance that scatters becomes the abundance that gathers — the street's surplus is the medium through which each party discovers itself as constituted by the others it was merely passing.

independent.recovered_law: TEXT B reverses directions and polarities: drawing/shooting outward becomes bearing/pouring inward, drowning/sinking becomes steeping/sitting, blowing past and getting looser becomes pulling up and getting closer — the relational flow shifts from outward dispersal and excess to inward gathering and containment.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same transformation: outward scattering/dispersal becomes inward gathering/containment, with surplus recast as a medium of mutual constitution rather than excess passing by.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the inward/gathering relation (closer, shared, pull up) rather than reverting to TEXT A's outward/excess pattern.
